about: IR Capture's shelf, laid out from irc-pieces.json (design/render/ircapture_kit.py) at 3.0 px a pt (8 pt a cm, so the boxes' fronts are 56 pt tall). Points. boxFace is the flat of the front face from the box picture's edges (top, leading, bottom, trailing); boxInsets the 3-slice (along x only, drawn at its own height); the plank strip's top sits plankBelowBoxTop under the box picture's top (box bottom on the plank's front top edge), its front edge ends plankFrontBottom into the strip. boxTop: the box pictures' top under the title bar (negative: their transparent top margin runs up behind it). gapBelowPlank: wall between the plank's front edge and the opening, where the opening's top moulding sits; the plank's shadow falls there.
